message: Upgrade to vg-paradigms release 2026.10.11 (CI only for contributor projects and checks no machine here can run; the rest in git hooks), by your auto subscription: its dry run broke nothing

text:
baseline = "vg-paradigms"

[license]

title: Baseline release 2026.10.11: render again (`tend baseline render --write`)
body:
+ ci.contributors-only: CI runs only where the checks before a push can't stand in for it: a project open to contributions (it declares itself open, and its repo is public), on others' pull requests and pushes, and on its release tags when others build on its releases; or a check no machine here can run, even handed to another through a Nix remote builder (say which, and why, beside the workflow). Every other project has no workflows and GitHub Actions turned off. Its declared tests and gates run in git hooks: tend's checks before every commit, and all of them before every push. Projects are closed unless they say otherwise, and none is open yet.
~ rust.ci-reads-toolchain: Where a project runs CI, it takes the toolchain from rust-toolchain.toml (rustup reads it when cargo runs); a workflow never pins a second version beside it, except a nightly where only nightly will do (Miri, fuzzing).
~ rust.clippy-clean: Code is clippy-clean with warnings denied (cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings), under every feature set the project builds.
- ci.on-demand
- ci.private-deps
scaffold deny.toml changed
guidance changed
